items.title: Midwest Energy gets REPM LoI for 1,200 MTPA at Rs 505.05/kg sales incentive
items.text: The Ministry of Heavy Industries issued a Letter of Intent to Midwest Energy Ltd, declared a successful bidder under the Rs 7,280 crore sintered REPM scheme, for 1,200 MTPA of capacity (the per-beneficiary maximum) at a quoted sales incentive rate of Rs 505.05 per kg. A Rs 40 crore performance security is due within 90 days, after which a Letter of Award follows. Midwest's Rs 250 crore Hyderabad plant has a 500 tpa Phase-I unit under commissioning, with a 1,500 MTPA target by end-2027. This is the first reported award step; Midwest Energy is a promoter-group entity, not the listed Midwest Ltd, so the listing link is indirect, and other awardees are not confirmed in the pages reviewed.

items.title: China extends pause on rare earth export curbs to 10 January, ahead of expiry on 10 November
items.text: China suspended export controls on some critical minerals for a further two months, extending its trade truce with the US to 10 January, before an expected Trump-Xi meeting at the APEC summit. Controls on seven heavy rare earth elements (imposed in April and expanded in October) were described as imposed earlier, and the article does not say which minerals the pause covers. For India's REPM scheme, the extension eases the near-term deadline flagged in the edition, but the pause is short and the licensing risk behind India's ~90% China dependence on NdFeB magnets remains. The article does not mention India.
